Metadata.title: Boomly: luggage storage at local shops near you
Metadata.description: Leave your bags with a trusted local shop near the station or the sights. Book online, €5 per bag per day.

Home.title: Drop your bags. Enjoy the city.
Home.subtitle: Leave your bags with a local shop near the station or the sights. Book in 1 minute and make the most of your day.
Home.priceNote: Free cancellation until your drop-off time.
Home.step1Text: Pick a drop-off point on the map, your times and number of bags. Pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, no account needed.
Home.step2Text: Show your QR code to the shopkeeper. They scan it and tag each bag.
Home.step3Text: Come back at the planned time; the shopkeeper scans your code again and hands your bags back.
Home.partnerText: Restaurant, bar, newsagent, boutique: earn extra income with no investment and welcome new passing customers.

Footer.tagline: Boomly stores nothing: your bags are kept by verified local shops.

Landing.subtitle: Leave your bags at a café, newsagent or shop near the station or the sights. From {price} per day, booked in one minute.
Landing.heroPhotoAlt: Traveller with her bag in the city
Landing.factPrice: starting price per bag per day
Landing.factShare: of each booking goes to the shop
Landing.step1Text: Find an open shop near you, pick your times and number of bags. Pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
Landing.step2Text: Show your QR code. The shopkeeper photographs your bags and puts a numbered tag on each one.
Landing.step3Text: Come back at the planned time: one scan and you’re off with your things. Enjoy the city hands-free.
Landing.pricesText: Per bag, per 24-hour period. No hidden fees, no subscription.
Landing.pricesNote: Free cancellation and full refund until your planned drop-off time.
Landing.cmpTitle: Why Boomly rather than a classic locker?

Landing.partnerTitle: Earn extra income, with zero investment.
Landing.partnerText: Restaurant, bar, newsagent, boutique: keep a few bags in a corner of your shop and earn {share}% of every booking, paid automatically.
Landing.partnerPoint1: Scan the QR code at drop-off and pick-up, from your phone
Landing.partnerPoint2: Photo of the bags at drop-off: you’re protected in case of dispute
Landing.partnerPoint3: You set your hours and capacity, pause any time
Landing.simNote: Estimate: {amount} per medium bag per day, 30 days a month.
Landing.faqText: Another question? Write to us, we reply fast.
Landing.faqA1: You book a drop-off point at a partner shop online, pay, then receive a QR code by email. The shopkeeper scans it when you drop off your bags, and again when you pick them up.
Landing.faqQ2: What size of bag can I leave?
Landing.faqA2: Any: small bag (backpack, handbag), medium bag (carry-on) or large bag (checked suitcase). The price depends on the size.
Landing.faqQ3: Can I cancel or change my booking?
Landing.faqA3: Yes. Cancellation is free with a full refund until your planned drop-off time. You can also change your times from the link sent by email.
Landing.faqQ4: What if I come back later than planned?
Landing.faqA4: If the shop is closed, your bags stay safe until it reopens. Each extra day is charged at the same rate, paid on site at pick-up.
Landing.faqA5: Every shop is checked by our team before going live. At drop-off, the shopkeeper photographs your bags and adds a numbered tag; everything is time-stamped. If something goes wrong, you can report an incident from your booking.
Landing.faqA6: Yes: cash, valuables, hazardous goods, perishable food and animals.
Landing.faqA7: No. An email address is enough: you’ll receive your confirmation, QR code and the link to manage your booking.
Landing.faqQ8: I run a shop, how do I become a partner?
Landing.faqA8: Register your shop in a few minutes, set up payouts with Stripe, then our team approves your listing. You’re paid automatically after each pick-up.
